notes.title: Patch #003
notes.content:
Vehicles & Driving
Velocity R handling has been improved (reduced understeer when cornering)

You can no longer change gears without using clutch


Levels
Green Forest

Some awkward turns have been improved

Fence weights adjusted, they now break much more easily

Fixed floating fences



Canyon

Some awkward turns have been improved

Fence weights adjusted, they now break much more easily

Fixed floating fences


Sound
Added gear shift sound

Added gear shift failure sound

Handbrake sound

Honk sound

Velocity R engine noise updated


Settings panel
Added "Honk" key binding option




Delivery completed screen
Added animations and sfx to stats section

notes.content: Fixed resolution settings applying the wrong resolution

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello! This is the first update to the game based on the first round of feedback. 

Besides the fixes mentioned below, this update also contains numerous minor bug fixes. 


Vehicle Physics
Pac, Velocity R and Trekker now have reduced understeer. 


Maps 
Canyon: fixed some fences automatically breaking on player spawn


Settings Menu
Fixed graphics settings showing up blank on initial launch of settings menu,

Fixed resolution settings causing window type to change.
